author: Julie Weiss
subject: Staff Treatment Protocol
body:
**Step 1: Submit Staff Treatment Request in Talent.** You will have 1 treatment request per quarter. If there are trainings or other opportunities, then other treatments may be possible. Treatments are at cost; if samples are available, then there may be opportunities for no-cost treatments. When submitting a request in Talent, go to “time off” request. Be very specific on what treatment you’re requesting. If it’s Botox, please indicate the areas you want treated.

**Step 2:** Management will approve in Talent HR.

**Step 3:** Management will book the appointment with an available provider during non-working and non-peak hours.

**Step 4:** The staff member is responsible for documenting the treatment in the Google Sheets document ([2026 Staff Treatment Log](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1U6u7L1bUjf7r6ev-gN58kFFI6sGbkKTIvuPdxP9Z0Sc/edit)). This document will be shared with all staff; please place it on your iPad home page. This is a critical step that must not be skipped. If you skip this step, you will be at risk of losing your staff treatment privileges.

**Step 5:** If it’s an Allergan product, you must document on the reimbursement sheet on staff fridge the name and amount of the product used.

replies.author: __owner__
replies.body:
A high-performing medspa should aim for a **rebooking rate of 80% or higher**, which measures patients scheduling their next appointment before leaving. While average rates often hover around 47–73%, setting an 80% goal ensures financial stability, higher provider productivity, and better client retention.

**Key Benchmarks and Targets:**
- Excellent: 80% or higher
- Good/Target: 60%–79%
- Needs Attention: Below 60%
- Average (Industry): ~47%–73% (Industry benchmarks vary, but 80% is the target for top-performing spas.)

**Strategies to Increase Percentage:**
- Train Front Desk: Ensure staff uses specific language like, "As mentioned, Amanda recommends 2 more sessions. Does Monday work, Amanda has 10am or 2pm?" rather than "Do you want to rebook?"
- **Book next appointment before patient checks out!**
- Focus on Consultations: Explain the necessity of the next visit during treatment. Give them an annual treatment plan and skincare regimen.
- Incentivize: Offer loyalty rewards or small discounts for booking before leaving.
- **Such as $25 off your next Botox or Diamond Glow when you prebook.**
- Track Regularly: Review metrics monthly to identify which providers are successful and where to improve.

**The below is each provider's OVERALL rebooking rate Q1 2026**

author: __owner__
subject: SOP: Prebooking Botox Patients
body:
**Effective 4/24/2026 · Applies to all providers, front desk staff and locations.**

# Target
**95%** of Botox patients prebook their next appointment before leaving the office.

# Patient incentive
$25 practice discount + $20 Alle dollars = **$45 total savings** on their next Botox treatment when they prebook.

# Steps
- **Treatment room (provider):** Review the treatment plan and interval (typically 3 months), explain the $45 savings, then walk the patient to the front desk.
- **Hand-off (provider):** "I would like Sara to prebook her next appointment with me in 3 months." Use flash cards so future treatments aren't said out loud in front of other patients. Highlight any converted Alle Flash offers; front desk turns them in to back office at the end of the day.
- **Checkout (front desk):** Offer the earliest dates first: "Ruth has Wednesday, July 8th at 10am or 2pm. Which works better for you?" Always try to book before the patient checks out.
- **Confirm and document:** Confirm the date and time aloud and note in Aesthetic Record that the patient prebooked and the incentive was applied.

# Handling objections
- "I'm not sure yet." → "No problem — most of our patients like to secure their favorite time slot early. If anything changes, we can always adjust."
- "I'll call later." → "Spots with your favorite provider fill up fast, plus you'll get the $45 savings today. Let's get you on the schedule now and you can always reschedule."

# Tracking
Pulled monthly from Aesthetic Record, posted here monthly and reviewed in monthly team meetings.

The full SOP is attached. **All clinical and front desk staff please review and acknowledge.**
